==Russian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|ru|бѣ́гать||ru-PRO}}

===Etymology===
{{root|ru|ine-pro|*bʰegʷ-}}
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*běgati}}, from {{der|ru|ine-pro|*bʰegʷ-}}, cognate with {{cog|lt|bėgti}} and {{cog|grc|φέβομαι||to flee}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|бе́гать}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-бегать.ogg}}
* {{audio|ru|LL-Q7737 (rus)-Tatiana Kerbush-бегать.wav|a=Saint Petersburg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|бе́гать|impf|pf=побе́гать|vn=бе́гание|vadj=бе́глый}}

# to [[run]]

====Usage notes====
* {{U:sla:directional verb|ru|multi|impf=бе́гать|pf=побе́гать|othimpf=бежа́ть|othpf=побежа́ть}}
* The compounds of {{m-self|ru|бе́гать}} are formed from {{m|ru|-бега́ть}}.

====Conjugation====
{{ru-conj|impf-intr|1a|бе́гать}}

====Derived terms====
* ''See {{m|ru|бежа́ть}} for derived verbs.''
